steps.text: Sear the mushrooms in a wide hot pan without moving until their edges go crisp.
Add scallion whites and rice, pressing the rice into an even layer against the pan.
Leave the rice untouched until a golden crust forms underneath.
Toss with soy, vinegar, and sesame oil; fry the eggs in the cleared side of the pan.
Spoon into bowls and crown with egg, scallion greens, and chile crisp.
